cohort: 75 RhD-negative postpartum women at Ahmedabad Civil Hospital, with 59 samples included in analysis after excluding those with Rh-negative or unknown fetal blood group.
finding: 45.76% of women had detectable FMH volumes ranging from 1.2 to 9.6 mL, while 54.24% had no detectable FMH; the majority had hemorrhage less than 4 mL, and none had large FMH.
